name: Sweet Corn Veg Instant Soup
ingredients_raw: Potato Starch, Sugar, Iodised Salt, Dried Glucose Syrup, Dehydrated Vegetables (15.7%) [Sweet Corn (11.5%), Carrot, Parsley], Flavour Enhancer (INS 635), Yeast Extract, Onion Powder, Chilli Powder, Pepper Powder, Turmeric Powder, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Garlic Powder, Sunflower Oil, Thickener (INS 415), Soy Sauce Powder (Soybean, Wheat, Salt), Anticaking Agent (INS 551), Nature Identical Flavouring Substances-Sweet Corn. ALLERGEN ADVICE: CONTAINS WHEAT AND SOY. May contain cereals containing Gluten (including Wheat), Peanuts, Tree Nuts, Sesame seeds, Soy, Mustard and Milk (dairy products).
